labels.name: component/service discovery
labels.rationale: The issue describes a panic in AWS EC2 service discovery due to missing nil checks in discovery/aws/ec2.go, which maps to the service discovery component.

items.message: Decision: ROUTE. Added label component/service discovery. Precheck: not maintainer-authored, bug template used but missing sections (version, config, logs, observed behavior), no security signals, no other project mentions. Duplicate candidates reviewed: #19184 (MSK, not EC2), #17343 (different symptom), #19261 (unrelated). Label validator accepted the label. No comment needed per procedure.
